messages:
alex: Heads-up: Marketplace returned PO 9999 for Pulsar Systems - failure code: PRICE_MISMATCH + ATTACHMENT_MISSING. Portal link: https://portal.marketplace.example/po/9999
finance-bot: PO 9999 rejected: PRICE_MISMATCH, ATTACHMENT_MISSING. See https://docs.marketplace/dev/po-errors#price-mismatch
maya: We sent the bundle price that included reseller discount, but marketplace pricebook has old MSP rate. Partner insists discount is valid per SOW. They attached the signed SOW but portal didn't ingest it.
trent: Is this the same SOW we uploaded last week? If portal didn't attach it, maybe file format issue (PDF/A vs PDF). Can someone re-upload as a flattened PDF? I can do that.
alex: Partner expects launch on Mon. If we can't resolve quickly, they'll request delayed billing which complicates revenue recognition. Finance says we need portal acceptance for invoicing.
maya: I'm asking partner to re-send SOW in flattened PDF and confirm reseller discount code. Also asked partner to confirm pricebook override in their merchant console.
ops-lead: If they can't re-upload, ops can manual-ingest with SOW attachment but it requires a $250 manual fee and 24hr SLA. Which do you prefer?
trent: Try re-upload first. If portal still rejects, ops-ingest. I'll prep the upload curl snippet now.
finance-bot: Note: mark deal-desk:urgent and tag revenueops for potential deferred recognition.
alex: Thanks. Maya, keep us posted. If partner confirms re-upload within 3h, we'll hold launch. If not, proceed with ops-ingest and fee approval.
